name: ENGR 1025
title: Engineering for Impact: Emerging Leaders
description: Supports the success of new or emerging engineering leaders for student organizations affiliated with the Vergnano Institute for Inclusion. May be repeated for a total of 4 credits.
requirement_description: Instructor consent required. Recommended Preparation: Should be a new or rising leader for an engineering student organization that is affiliated with the Vergnano Institute for Inclusion.
